title: Arkret Actor Profile Operations
description: Authorized anti-enumeration display view of a co-member global Actor Profile, served by the authenticated own Station. The ordinary profile Event is provenance, not a complete CRDT proof. The operation grants no identity, capability or membership authority and never requires an ordinary Event to obtain Seal coverage.

resolve_request.description: Resolves current global Actor Profiles for actors the caller currently shares realm_id with. The caller MUST be an effective joined member of realm_id and every returned actor MUST also be one at evaluation time; realm_id is the authorization basis, not a display hint.

realm_id.description: Shared Collaboration Realm establishing the relationship. A Principal Control Realm MUST NOT be used here: PCR co-membership is the owner's own devices and would make this operation a self-read with an outward shape.

profile_event.description: An exact eligible profile Event contributing to the current display projection, selected from its active heads in canonical EventId order. It is provenance only: concurrent heads and patch ancestry are not proven complete by this one Event. The service must return profile_unavailable if no eligible and disclosable source Event exists. Its Realm is the owner PCR; this limited disclosure never permits other PCR Events.

resolved_actor_profile.description: One actor display projection from the authenticated own Station and an exact accepted profile Event contributing to it. The Station validates ordinary eligibility and causal reduction before serving it. A single patch Event does not prove the full projection, conflict freedom, historical completeness or global freshness. An independent verifier needs the complete authorized causal/evidence closure; this DTO makes no such proof claim. Neither field is a grant, selector authority or identity-resolution authority. Ordinary profile Events have no covering Seal.

resolve_failure.description: Per-actor failure. The reason vocabulary is deliberately single-valued: unknown actor, actor without an accepted profile, actor that is not an effective joined member of realm_id, and a caller not authorized for that actor MUST all report profile_unavailable so the operation cannot be used to probe membership or account existence.

resolve_outcome.description: Closed outcome. Every requested actor_id appears exactly once across profiles and failures, so a caller cannot distinguish an omitted actor from a withheld one.
